contract.name: Marco
contract.goal: Gran fondo, 120 km with 2,000 m climbing
contract.notes: Indoor trainer on weekdays, outdoor on weekends.

plan.week_summary: Taper week focused on reducing overall volume while preserving neuromuscular sharpness with short race-pace openers ahead of your Gran Fondo. Total weekly volume is kept low to ensure fresh legs on race day.

days.title: Rest Day
days.purpose: Promote systemic recovery and adaptation at the start of the taper.
days.structure: Complete rest day. Hydrate well and get quality sleep.

days.title: Easy Indoor Spin
days.purpose: Maintain aerobic circulation and keep legs moving with minimal fatigue.
days.structure: 45 min smooth indoor trainer ride in Zone 1-2, maintaining high cadence (90-100 RPM).

days.title: Taper Openers
days.purpose: Touch on race intensity to maintain neuromuscular sharpness without building fatigue.
days.structure: 15 min easy warm-up, 4 x 3 min at threshold effort with 3 min easy spin recovery, 21 min easy cool-down.

days.title: Recovery Indoor Ride
days.purpose: Flush residual fatigue from Wednesday's openers.
days.structure: 45 min easy indoor spin strictly in Zone 1.

days.title: Rest Day
days.purpose: Allow full metabolic and muscular recovery before the weekend.
days.structure: Complete rest. Optional light stretching or mobility work.

days.title: Outdoor Taper Long Ride
days.purpose: Practice Gran Fondo pacing and climbing position without draining energy stores.
days.structure: 20 min easy warm-up, 50 min moderate tempo ride on rolling hills with short steady climb efforts, 20 min easy cool-down.

days.title: Outdoor Easy Spin
days.purpose: Promote active recovery and check gear for race week.
days.structure: 45 min easy outdoor spin on flat terrain in Zone 1.
